hypothesis: Explicit Poisson measurement-noise correction improves biological source estimation and unpaired source matching relative to a dimension-matched uncorrected estimator on the existing panels.
input: Frozen raw_counts, library_depth and opaque cell/feature IDs only; no feature reselection, extra modalities, new worlds or locked cohorts.
training_split: Sort training cell IDs by SHA256 of 'count-dica-v1:' + ID. First floor(0.75*n) rows fit sources/rank; remaining rows calibrate fingerprints. No public test rows or reference data used in fitting or decisions.
exposure_definition: unit=1; leave_panel_out=(original library_depth-original selected30 count sum)/median of that quantity on the source-fitting split. Compute before permutations and keep fixed. The second is a proxy sensitivity, not known technical exposure.
permutation: Independently shuffle integer feature columns within each own-assay exposure stratum, separately in fit/calibration splits. Unit exposure uses one stratum; leave_panel_out uses up to 8 rank-based strata. Diagnostic exchangeability approximation, not biological false-discovery control.

rank.rule: Standardize corrected covariance by fixed observed-rate SDs from source-fit rows. For each eigenvalue compute p=(1+number of null maximum eigenvalues >= observed)/50 using49 permutations; retain positive eigenvalues with p<=0.05. Zero rank is permitted. This selects coherent cross-feature signal above marginally preserved noise, not the total latent/private dimension. Both estimators use this same selected rank.
rank.cap_policy: Report the uncapped selection; cap binds => source matching ineligible, no silent claim that dimension is six.

source_estimator: Poisson-corrected covariance and third factorial cumulants; whiten all observed features, spectral diagonalization with eight seeded contractions, select smallest third-tensor offdiagonal residual. Ablation uses ordinary moments, same rank and seeds. Plug-in moment estimators, not unbiased finite-sample cumulant claims.

bootstrap.operation: Independently resample fit and calibration cells within each assay; hold selected dimension/exposure normalization fixed; refit sources, align columns by Hungarian absolute cosine in fixed standardized feature units, carry signs into fingerprints.

fingerprint.corrected_cf: exp(-i*t*w*fit_mean) times calibration-cell mean of product_j(1+i*t*w_j/exposure)^count_j. Uncorrected arm uses empirical CF of projected observed rates. Finite grid is only a consistency screen; no full-law identification claim.
fingerprint.cf_gate: Finite estimates and max log-weight <=300; estimated complex second-moment standard error <=0.1 at every frequency; point |phi|<=1.1. Empirical variance may miss rare tails; this gate is not an integrability proof.
fingerprint.centering_scaling: Demixing is fixed from source-fit covariance with unit modeled variance. CF uses source-fit mean and that fixed scale; skewness/kurtosis subsequently centralize and standardize using calibration projected moments. Bootstrap repeats this estimation. Neither finite-sample fingerprint nor estimated directions have an exact unbiasedness guarantee.
fingerprint.source_gate: No rank-cap binding; finite positive calibration projected variance; third-tensor relative offdiagonal residual <=0.35; at least26/32 successful aligned bootstrap fingerprints; median aligned loading cosine >=0.9 and 10th percentile >=0.7.
fingerprint.pair_rule: For each sign, concatenate normalized moment and real/imag CF differences. Accept practical equivalence only when max absolute point difference plus the 90th percentile of bootstrap maximum centered discrepancy <=1. At least26 valid paired bootstrap replicates; unique sign and mutual one-to-one candidate required. Report all ambiguity sets. No p-value/FDR/full-law interpretation.
fingerprint.all_assay_rule: Only sign-consistent cliques of unique accepted pair matches count as all-assay candidates. Pair candidates and all-assay candidates are separate readouts.

graph: Reuse pinned native Sturma pure-child/order extraction with gamma0.2 on raw rate mixing units only for >=2 all-assay candidate sources; report anonymous exploratory coefficients and numerical failures. The heuristic threshold is scale dependent. Finite-grid source equivalence and model fit do not establish the causal assumptions; do not label the output an identified graph.

evaluation.when: After all fit artifacts and their hashes are sealed; separate evaluator reads heldout references.
evaluation.primary_real: Heldout paired cross-covariance of counts/exposure, divided by fixed source-fit observed-rate SDs, compared with model candidate-shared mixing crosscovariance on the identical scale and with zero. Pair-bootstrap200 replicates and seed3000 describe uncertainty only.
evaluation.secondary_real: Model-implied correlation including Poisson noise in marginal variances; compare with heldout Pearson on valid feature pairs. No causal truth exists for this real panel.
evaluation.within_assay: Heldout observed-rate covariance versus fitted low-rank signal covariance plus model noise diagonal (zero for the uncorrected ablation), and versus diagonal source-fit observed covariance. Moment prediction, not heldout likelihood.
evaluation.simulation: All-source and matched-source noisy projected-score correlations with existing public-discovery state coordinates. Descriptive state recovery; no scoring anonymous latent graphs against the separate focal graph.
evaluation.native_reference: Frozen prior native result: numerical ranks30 and zero shared sources in all18 original/control arms. Different internal sample use makes it a contextual reference; the matched-rank ablation is the controlled comparison.

failure_policy: Record every abstention, numerical failure, warning and bootstrap failure; retain complete artifacts. Never replace an output directory or choose a seed using test performance.
scope: This bounded model is conditional Poisson with an affine independent-source rate model. NB feature noise, nonlinear rates, source-law population shifts and endogenous depth can violate it. It tests whether Poisson correction suffices; it cannot isolate all count noise or certify direct peak-gene causal recovery.
